source: This distinction explains a common profiling surprise: a kernel can have respectable occupancy yet still issue inefficiently because too few active warps are eligible at the moments that matter. Conversely, a kernel can run well at moderate occupancy if it exposes enough instruction-level parallelism and keeps the relevant pipelines supplied.
zh: 这种区别解释了一个常见的分析意外：内核可以拥有相当可观的占用率，但仍然发出低效，因为在重要时刻符合条件的活动扭曲太少。相反，如果内核暴露了足够的指令级并行性并保持相关管道的供应，则它可以在适度的占用率下运行良好。
